# "endpoint | path" the demo may answer though Jira's recording lacks it,
# each with its reason. Prefer giving the recorded projects (LAN, LWC on
# corne-team) data that shows the path over a line here.

# The recording account sees only the system dashboard, which has no owner;
# Jira sends the owner of any other (expand=owner).
GET /rest/api/3/dashboard/search 200 | values[].owner

# Cards ask for resolution and resolutiondate (the all issues view) since
# the recording was made; re-recording on corne-team verifies them.
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/backlog 200 | issues[].fields.resolution
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/backlog 200 | issues[].fields.resolutiondate
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/issue 200 | issues[].fields.resolution
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/issue 200 | issues[].fields.resolutiondate
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/sprint/{id}/issue 200 | issues[].fields.resolution
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/sprint/{id}/issue 200 | issues[].fields.resolutiondate
POST /rest/api/3/search/jql 200 | issues[].fields.resolution
